verdict.rationale: Evidence shows OpenHands integrates with GitHub for triggering workflows and opening PRs (e.g., fixing failed workflows, remediating security alerts, PR review automation), implying repo connection and PR creation capability. However, there's no explicit documentation of the repo-connection setup flow (auth, permissions) or confirmation that arbitrary developer-initiated coding tasks against a connected repo result in opened PRs versus just automated triggers. Missing for 10: explicit docs on connecting/authorizing a GitHub repo, end-to-end example of an agent opening a PR from a manual developer task, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
